featured_reviews.name: liya chacko
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a loyal Westside customer for over 10 years, which makes this experience even more disappointing. I visited the store multiple times to claim my birthday month offer. On one visit, I was told the offer would be activated the following month. After making three separate trips, I was then informed that the offer had to be claimed during the birthday month itself.

The staff provided inconsistent and misleading information, resulting in a complete waste of my time. For a brand of Westside’s stature and a store located in such a prime location, the customer service was extremely poor and far below expectations. This experience has left me very disappointed.

featured_reviews.name: SAYAN SAMANTA
featured_reviews.review_text: Worst store manager. First they let me sit on tool as my wife was trying out dress. then the store manager asked me to get up as i cant occupy the seat so long. While my wife was still occupied in trial room. such mean behaviour I didn’t expect from a brand like westside.

featured_reviews.name: Jessica
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing customer service.
I’ve been a loyal customer of this Westside for nearly a decade, but this experience has ensured I won’t return. Alteration requests were repeatedly mishandled despite multiple confirmations, forcing me to make several unnecessary visits. Staff showed poor communication, zero accountability, and no urgency to resolve the issue. My time, energy, and money were completely wasted. A real shame, especially for a store in such a prime locality.

featured_reviews.name: Rahil Mulla
featured_reviews.review_text:
This was honestly one of the most frustrating and disappointing experiences I’ve ever had. The mall closing time is 9 PM — I reached at 9:05, just 5 minutes late — and despite clearly explaining that my friends were already inside and actively shopping, the security guard bluntly refused to let me enter.

What kind of unreasonable and rigid rule is this? If customers are still inside making purchases, how does it make any sense to stop someone from joining them just because of a 5-minute delay? There was absolutely no effort to understand the situation or offer any flexibility — just a flat-out denial with no logic behind it.

Because of this, I couldn’t even try the items my friends had bought, completely ruining the whole experience. This kind of behavior shows a complete lack of customer consideration and basic common sense. Extremely poor management and highly disappointing service.

Security guard name is Sanam
